title: Reticora domain event
description: Envelope of the domain events of EVT-01/EVT-02, published on the NATS stream RETICORA_EVENTS under events.<org_id>.<type> and delivered to webhook subscriptions. Delivery is at least once: a consumer recognizes a repeated event by its id and processes the events of one entity in entity_seq order.

id.description: Unique id of the event; the NATS message id.

occurred_at.description: When the mutation that raised the event was written.

sequence.description: Position of the event among the organization's events, in commit order without gaps.

entity_id.description: The entity the event concerns (for ci.* the CI id).

entity_seq.description: Position of the event among the events of its entity.

data.description: The event data; for ci.* the CI, for ci.changed with changed_fields.
